items.title: What Could Lam Research (LRCX) Change With Its $15 Million STEM Education Push?
items.summary: Lam Research (NasdaqGS:LRCX) announced a US$15 million global STEM education partnership on 13 November 2026. The company will become a founding sponsor of a new global LEGO League initiative focused on hands-on STEM learning for students. The funding is aimed at supporting science and engineering education programs across multiple countries through classroom and competition-based activities. items.title: Applied Materials Sinks 6% After Record Quarter as 10 Analysts Cut Targets; Morningstar Calls AI Worries “Overblown”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApplied Materials stock fell 6% today after a record quarter, as its revenue guide missed estimates and at least 10 firms cut their price targets. Management said supply limits held back the guide, and it sees wafer fab equipment spending up more than 30% in 2027.
